sections.title: Talk about routines
sections.content: Use the present tense with time expressions to describe habitual free-time routines.

sections.title: Habitual activities
rows: Every week I listen to music.

items.english: On Mondays I read at home.
In the afternoon I listen to music.

sections.content: Time expressions such as *los lunes*, *cada semana* and *por la tarde* make a repeated routine clear.
